# Filekind

> Free image and PDF tools that run entirely in the browser. Files are never uploaded: compression, resizing, conversion, and PDF assembly all happen on the user's device. No signup, no watermark.

Filekind covers the everyday tasks that block uploads and forms: shrinking a photo to a KB limit, changing image dimensions, converting between common formats, building a PDF from pictures, and turning PDF pages back into images.

## Tools

- [Compress image](https://filekind.tech/compress-image): Reduce a JPEG or PNG to a custom KB or MB limit; the result is verified at or below the target.
- [Resize image](https://filekind.tech/resize-image): Set exact pixels or a percentage, with an aspect-ratio lock and JPG or PNG output.
- [Convert image](https://filekind.tech/convert-image): Convert between JPG, PNG, and static WebP in any direction.
- [Images to PDF](https://filekind.tech/images-to-pdf): Arrange images into one PDF, with fit, A4, or Letter page sizes and margins.
- [PDF to images](https://filekind.tech/pdf-to-images): Render each complete PDF page as a JPG or PNG, downloadable individually or as a ZIP.
- [JPG to PDF](https://filekind.tech/jpg-to-pdf), [PNG to PDF](https://filekind.tech/png-to-pdf), [WebP to PDF](https://filekind.tech/webp-to-pdf): Single-format routes into the PDF builder.
- [PDF to JPG](https://filekind.tech/pdf-to-jpg), [PDF to PNG](https://filekind.tech/pdf-to-png): Single-format routes out of the PDF renderer.

- [Image and PDF glossary](https://filekind.tech/glossary): Plain-language definitions of JPEG, PNG, WebP, resolution, DPI, compression, and more.

- [Image tools hub](https://filekind.tech/image-tools) and [PDF tools hub](https://filekind.tech/pdf-tools).
- [Site directory](https://filekind.tech/directory): Every page on the site.

## Optional

- Image input limits: 25 MB, 16,000 pixels per side, 48 megapixels. PDF input: 50 MB, 100 pages.
- Supported image formats: JPEG, PNG, static WebP. Not supported: HEIC, GIF, BMP, TIFF, SVG, AVIF, animated WebP.
- Filekind does not provide OCR, PDF editing, PDF compression, cropping, rotating, watermarking, or batch processing.
